lines.x: Crude oil has resumed flowing through a section of the Iraq-Turkey Pipeline after a 12-year suspension, following an announcement by the oil minister.
Iraq restarted pumping crude oil through a pipeline to Türkiye at an initial capacity of 120,000 barrels per day to bypass Strait of Hormuz transit disruptions.
The Iraq Stock Exchange benchmark RSISX index rose 1.75% in the trading week ending November 19, settling at 2,334.3 points in dinars and 1,993.2 points in US dollar terms.
Iraq's federal government is using an oil-smuggling case south of Baghdad to pressure the Kurdistan Regional Government to hand over more crude and grant inspectors access to fields.
